A definition lets air through its panes. A speaker who has understood capture discovers himself seeking its soothing once more. Taylor's poems give these returns different bodies. Their sounds, intervals, pronouns and endings let the relation be lived before an account collects it. The poems remain twenty-three individual works within this authored whole; a shared philosophical field gives them relations without making them fragments of an unwritten master poem. The [Personal Poetry Corpus](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#complete-poems) **sources** the complete texts below. It distinguishes ten undated earlier works, the six-work P0→P5 composition, and seven dated journal works from March–June 2026. The order here is that compilation's order; it does not pretend that the June sequence chronologically preceded the March poems. Bracketed first-line titles are indexes where no authorial title was found. Each quotation retains the compilation's exact wording and lineation. Subsequent authorial corrections are stated beside their own poems so that text, revision instruction and commentary remain distinguishable. This is Taylor's situated authorial world. The language is English; the dated journal encounters and June composition supply particular occasions of production. No birthplace or geographical route is inferred from a file location. [Neumann's shared archetypal ground](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round) carries the structuration of genesis, world-parent relation, opposition, differentiation, separation and renewed interplay. That common morphology remains distinct from the geography of particular tellings and from the order and duration of their transformations. It makes relations comparable without converting Taylor's dated works into stages of a universal cultural chronology. The psychological morphology and Taylor's native derivation also keep distinct source offices. The native field is complete before a local image receives a formal reading: `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, `1/0`. The slash and inverted parent enclose neither a miscellaneous list nor a one-way ladder. Each parent opens its full four-and-two articulation, and return permits the inverse passage. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3, and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 give the sequential harmonics; Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4, and Text/Texture at 2+3 give a different, complementary reading. The [core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **sources** that authorial field. Its `X/x` is Taylor's notation. Neither Neumann nor a poem supplies its derivation retrospectively. The sixfold of this page follows the corpus's own changing forms; it does not distribute all twenty-three works among six prefabricated meanings. The prose immediately following a poem describes its words and complete movement. Symbolic amplification is identified separately: **human-amplified: yes** where the authored programme or a precise correction supplies the relation; additional interpretive extrapolation remains **human-amplified: no**. Reading a complete work is not permission to assign every bird, vessel or god-name a fixed cross-story identity. ## #1 — Play, knowing, and the humanity that makes its forms The earlier works move among address, recognition, institutional desire and release. Their lengths matter: the two-line fatigue of waking and the extended rain against the window of freedom do different work. Each begins again in its own voice. ### FT-P01 — Play and Play > Somehow, being right here > I am out there, everywhere, > Nowhere really, > And elsewhere completely. > Coming and Going; > Checkmate. > Another game? > I might as well stay knowing > If I set you going > You'll come again. > Let us play and play. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q001) · Extracted authorial poem. The voice moves from being here to being everywhere and nowhere, reaches checkmate, then asks for another game. Staying in knowing and setting another going belong to one invitation: the other can come again. The final repetition of play opens what the apparent ending had closed. Its address to you is part of that reopening; the poem would lose its return if reduced to an assertion that everything is one. ### FT-P02 — Mystery Is Infinitely Deeper > Mystery is infinitely deeper than the simply unknown or unknowable; > It is the relative knowability of the Unknown > And the ultimate unknowability of the Known; > The Known alone is the wrong focal point for Knowing, and it will always spit back at us the empty husk; > Knowing itself is the Mystery, > The conjugal Joy of the Known and the Knower, eternally trussed. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q002) · Extracted authorial poem. The first turn gives the Unknown a relative knowability and removes final possession from the Known. The husk is what comes back when knowing fixes exclusively on its object. The last two lines restore the act and its participants: Known and Knower are held in a conjugal relation whose joy belongs to Knowing. Mystery therefore deepens as the relation becomes articulate; accumulating an inventory of unknown things would miss the poem's change of focus. ### FT-P03 — It Takes One to Know One > It's certainly true that it takes one to know one. > Truer still that it takes the One to Know the One. > Thus True Knowing takes one and makes one no one, just so that no-one, One, knows One. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q003) · Extracted authorial poem. The familiar saying passes through three changes of case and agency. One recognises another; the One knows the One; knowing then takes the separate claimant through no-one. The final line lets the repeated word keep several offices without allowing the individual knower to retain possession of them all. Its commas and capitals perform those turns. A uniform spelling of one would remove the differences through which this recognition proceeds. ### FT-P04 — The Zero and the One > The 0 is the One, the 1 is the All! Thus the All is none, once and for all. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q004) · Extracted authorial poem. The single breath distinguishes the whole One at 0 from the enumerated All at 1, then releases the latter's claim to finality through none and once and for all. The wit depends on the Two Ones retaining different offices. This is Taylor's numerical poetic expression; its symbolic use of number travels back to the native derivation rather than supplying an independent arithmetic proof. ### FT-P05 — Every Field Is a Way > Every field is a way, > Every way a field > Born to yield > Truth unconcealed > So vistas open > In the day's veil > And paths lead on > Ever availed > > As is the seal > Wont to entail > The opening of sight > And sense's portrayal > Too the bird in flight > The wind regales > The end all and be all > From Real to re-All [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q005) · Extracted authorial poem. Field becomes way and way becomes field before either can close into an object. The first stanza makes disclosure a movement through vistas and paths. The second gives the seal an opening office, then lets sight become flight in the wind. Real returns as re-All: the poem re-enters the field of particulars from the reality they disclose. Its sound pattern carries the transition through yield, veil, entail and portrayal; none of those words alone substitutes for the passage. ### FT-P06 — Searching High and Low > Searching high and low, > near and far for a clue; > Who's to know, and > In deed, > Who ever knew? > The Truth's as much what ever was > As what's ever anew. > No secret is safe with I; > About Time the Truth flew, > For the many > As much as for the few. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q006) · Extracted authorial poem. Searching changes from a question about where the clue lies to a question about who knows. What ever was and what is ever anew meet within the same Truth. The final movement releases the secret from exclusive custody: it flies for the many as much as the few. The capital I and the play on Time belong to this turn from seeking outward to making what is known available. ### FT-P07 — I Dream Of > I dream of a truly Humanised spirituality, > And of the truly Spiritualised human — > Failing this, there will be nothing and no one to seek. > > I dream of institutions which respect their constitution, > And don't devour the humanity that made and makes them [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q007) · Extracted authorial poem. The first stanza makes humanisation and spiritualisation reciprocal tasks, with the possibility of seeking itself at stake. The second gives that reciprocity an institutional demand. Humanity both made and makes the institution; the present tense prevents an originating act from becoming an exhausted historical credit. An institution that consumes this continuing humanity devours its own constitution. The poem's dream is an expressed aspiration with a social consequence. ### FT-P08 — Waking Up > Waking up is just a matter of getting tired > Of all the bullshit. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q008) · Extracted authorial poem. The first line raises the expectation of an account of awakening and brings it down to getting tired. The second names what exhausts the speaker. The shortness matters: the poem offers no ladder of superior attainments after that exhaustion, and its final word declines the decorum through which the same evasion could continue. ### FT-P09 — Freedom > Tell me; how is freedom free > If it be > Bound by law and > Contingency? > Freedom is a rule to itself > Or better yet > The Rule of The Self. > It's no pittance felt > Of irony dealt > In a house of liberation > Admonition, pelt lifted, > Rain against the window > Of Soul; > The eye of the wind within > Shan't know the pigeonhole; > The message comes through regardless. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q009) · Extracted authorial poem. Freedom begins under examination: how could it remain free while being bound by law and contingency? Rule changes its office when the poem passes from a rule to itself to the Rule of The Self. The house of liberation then meets rain at its window. By the end, wind, eye and message pass beyond the pigeonhole that would classify their arrival. This is a movement in the experience of freedom, not a legislative claim that every particular action is exempt from consequence. ### FT-P10 — Beyond All Borders > Beyond all borders, Knowing without defense, > Beyond all realities, Being, True without pretense. > Without defense, no wars for waging, nor could there be waging against. > Without pretense, no amount of slighting can even slightly sully sense. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q010) · Extracted authorial poem. The opening pair gives Knowing and Being parallel releases from defence and pretence. The following pair pursues what each release makes possible: war loses its occasion in one, while slighting cannot soil sense in the other. The last line tests its claim in sound, letting slighting approach slightly without letting injury acquire the final authority to determine what is real. ## #2 — Two roads, six works, and the return through the loop The P0→P5 order belongs to this composition. P3 and P4 are a consequential pair: one unfolds the productive play of distinction, the other addresses its severing misuse. Their complementary lean is **human-amplified: yes** in the authored six-route programme. A return through the sequence does not create a seventh poem. ### FT-P11 — P0: The two roads of two > 2 → (−1) + 1 = 0 > 2 → 0/1 → 00, 01, 10, 11 + 0, 1 = 4 + 2 [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q011) · Extracted authorial poem. Both routes begin with two. The first resolves the poles as opposed signed ones and cancels them to zero. The second retains 0 and 1, generates their four ordered pairings, and keeps the generating two alongside the four: 4+2. The printed rows are the entire numerical poem. Their difference is the fate of relation under the two operations, not a preference for one decorative numeral over another. ### FT-P12 — P1: What binary cannot compute > What binary cannot compute, > What thinking cannot know, > Where two see the common root, > There our powers grow. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q012) · Extracted authorial poem. The shared root enters where binary computation and thinking meet their stated limits. Two recognise it, and our powers grow: the ending moves into the first-person plural. Following the numerical fork, this small poem makes the increase of power dependent on a relation that the isolated poles could not supply. Its claim remains in the native and poetic register; it reports no benchmark about computing machines. ### FT-P13 — P2: Where life leads > Where life leads, > There words transfix. > Where life flows, > There words shall slip. > Where language stays, > Understanding frays, > Let language cave, > And lay bare the way, > Over the edge, under the lips. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q013) · Extracted authorial poem. Life leads and flows while words alternately transfix and slip. When language stays, understanding frays; language must then cave to lay the way bare. Cave changes from a possible enclosure into an enacted yielding. The last line crosses the edge beneath the lips, bringing the physical place of speech into the release of speech. Its own words accomplish the approach to their limit. ### FT-P14 — P3: 2 to two ones > 2 to two ones, one or the other one, summed to none, already a one and done-er. > > 2 through the two ones, the whole and natural number, where one as first is both rooted in none and number, the 0 and 1, One and All, never rent asunder. Never falling into enmity, two plays itself apart and becomes again projected by it's chiaroscuric/contrastive arts, two upon itself, plus itself, 4+2. Looking back with love it wraps itself up, 6 perfection seeking recollection of the one that is it's two, ring around the Rosie until you fall down through the loop. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q014) · Extracted authorial poem. The prepositions carry the fork: two goes to two opposed ones in the opening stanza, and through the Two Ones in the second. Differentiation is playful and productive here. Contrast projects two upon itself while retaining its generating pair, then love turns the six toward recollection. The children's ring ends by falling through the loop. The ending changes the meaning of perfection: completing the figure makes return possible rather than enthroning a finished enclosure. ### FT-P15 — P4: There’s one underlying issue in our age > There’s one underlying issue in our age. One could say, One is the underlying issue of our age… Let me rephrase, how the One is to one, this underscores and is setting our stage. Collectively we haven’t a frame open enough to let the evening wane or the one air in through released panes, to be breathed all the same. Are you one? Are we one whole together? Galaxies, planets, seasons, angels, demons, bodies, bots, the weather? Where between each one is One’s tether? Two is the first sign that one must endeavour, married to the bond by a lifetime of together, time dividing not for war but for dreaming towards forever. The one issue; we forgot that one really is two. We almost always see to two as two, because mind must split, divide and polarise, to know is to sever. What amounts, by all accounts, isn’t very clever. Firstly, it is completely derived. So late on the scene did this thinking arise, yet its high water mark is hubris despite; each apotheosis a reason to demonise. Secondly it measures by limiting a sky, by making a cloud where an aeon could fly, blocking light to reify. Third it seals with patterned definition, neither side holds the other, nor self recognition. Alive is a logic landing humility as provision, as primary and axiomatic, as prerequisite of precision. We start with the sky open wide, with the one truth for which thought has no vision, ever aloof, zero-and-one as one impossible act of re-cognition. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q015) · Extracted authorial poem. The poem opens with an issue in our age and turns one into One before widening the scene through panes, air, planets, bodies and weather. Two makes the bond perceptible; time can divide for a shared future. The critique of severance then gives three reasons: the cutting mind is derived, its measure limits the sky, and its definitions seal each side away from the other. Humility enters as a prerequisite of precision. Read with P3, this preserves productive differentiation while exposing the cut that forgets its bond; the open sky at the end answers the blocked frame at the beginning. ### FT-P16 — P5: God is not a thing to argue over > God is not a thing to argue over, to believe in or deny; it is a word with many contexts, evolutions and definitions, that points somewhere no word can stand. Every word is born of difference, hold the different ones in hand; left and right run away from each other, but together master the span. We define God in terms that require no belief; we use numbers as symbols to express what words alone couldn't reach. Before All, God has always been the One, and yet we're beached, 2000+ years and the formula unimpeached. Number is the language of demonstrative proof, not age-doctored doctrines distilled from real visionary excretes. We offer a coherent and evolving account of God, one that includes it's own release; whereof one must be silent, there one shouldn't speak. And yet the essence of the project is to find the limit, so, to speak. [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q016) · Extracted authorial poem. God moves from a proposed object of dispute into a word whose pointing exceeds the place words can occupy. Left and right master a span together; symbolic number enters the account, and the account includes its own release. The close turns an injunction to silence through three small pauses, so, to, speak. Those pauses make finding the limit an act of language. The historical duration and doctrinal polemic inside the verse remain Taylor's utterance; quoting the complete poem does not turn them into independently established history. ## #3 — Dated encounters and the speaker changed by speaking The journal poems return to a speaker who undergoes what he can articulate. March gives contradiction a social and bodily pressure; May develops the unnamed referent, difference and feeling; June lets a fitting form be returned. The changes happen within particular works and dates, not in an imposed developmental ranking. ### FT-P17 — [Bullshit and horror so plain and clear] > Bullshit and horror so plain and clear, > everyday normality still, for most, remaining dear, > yet not much more than façade on veneer, > and yet I love them all, despite my hatred and their fear [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q017) · Extracted authorial poem. Horror and everyday normality occupy the same four-line field. Façade on veneer doubles the thinness of what remains dear, but the ending does not give the speaker the comfort of abandoning its inhabitants. Love is spoken alongside my hatred and their fear. The pronouns keep that difficult implication personal. In the journal this arrives after Taylor's pressure that nothing changes while all is change, and the admission that the next move remains possible without predicting its outcome. ### FT-P18 — [The scratching is the itch] > The scratching is the itch, what a stitch up! > I could see from an early age the world rearrange the way a wish cut, > such that our basic needs became the feed of our own eventual disgust, > beyond that which we discuss, > the feed stock of what makes ugly the lives, half-dead, that we live-up, > and I could never live it down, so taking to task the takedown > I did propound in my heart the twisted means by which desires abound > and thus could let one outmatch their amount, > yet I was swallowed up nonetheless, > in need of soothing my distress, > the winds of change and the naivety razed left me, despite knowing better from best, one and the same with the washing of the brain, > My failed test, another expiremental success, > Only now split within, between the kid and sin, > two hearts in one breast as the great ones did hint, > but by dint of this duality my reality did rescind - > I am blessed to know those who can hold open the door to my own way, > mostly they live in the realm that is no-way, the regions of life to which modernity has no say, > bar those whose role in the game is to curtail for their own sake. > But time has conspired to set the pot ablaze, fired to let the colours bake into the vessel of a new age, > set against and upon the stage that is built of impotences own rage, funnily enough it's saving grace. > I could lament my not having acted sooner, my having kept the cards close to my chest but then I'd have been another assumer, another reporter or truther, another speaking from, not to, distress. > Time has conspired because time is all our breathing, > and I am a bitter pill, sweet coating, relieving, > I am a symbol unbelieving, of the hauling and the heaving, > and I must be on the line if I am to bait the nourishment for our healing. > I was told today that a choice must be made between what sooths me to sleep and what let's me entrain > those very forces whose captured uptake has left the cleft wide open without the voice of the age... > And how has it left me? Returning to the same old pattern, recapitulating the stagnation > I rail against in what happens to simply be the inertia of the everyday "I must have (x)". But it's not eradication I seek, for underneath the sense of me has handed over to the action's own speech, of which my entire soul as aperture is a mouth to be breached, > and I know that what will settle is a natural mettle, and an incoussiant valuation of what takes me from my station to my peak. > But without the choice I am idle, with it I'm besseched. > It is no trite accretion of the image of the anointed, nor bland convalescence to the inversion appointed, but a true reconciliation in me of the brothers, > for how else can I become the right light unto others? [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q018) · Extracted authorial poem. The attempt to understand manufactured desire is itself swallowed by the need for soothing. The speaker's knowledge does not spare him the capture he describes. Kid and sin become two hearts in one breast; the opened door and the firing of a vessel then make a different use of the same forces imaginable. The later distinction between speaking from distress and speaking to it changes the speaker's office. Time, breath and the bitter pill bring that change toward a choice between soothing sleep and entrainment. Even after this choice appears, stagnation returns. The last movement explicitly seeks no eradication: reconciliation of the brothers within must make the speaker capable of becoming a right light to others. The final revised witness preserves this aftermath, which an excerpt ending at the kiln would lose. ### FT-P19 — [The unchanging is beyond consequence] > The unchanging is beyond consequence, but is the opposite of inconsequential... What allows for an essence is essentially inessential... What builds for itself a journey is perpetually residential... > Sojourning through time yet unmovingly presidential... Silent but in structure reverential... Context total yet totally incidental... Foundation of mind, unfound by the mental... [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q019) · Extracted authorial poem. The referent is withheld while seven clauses disclose what depends upon it. Beyond consequence does not mean inconsequential; residence remains within journey, and movement through time does not displace what presides. The final clause locates the mind's foundation beyond the mind's finding. Taylor explicitly resisted replacing the withheld referent with atman or witness: naming either draws it into the distinctions the poem is traversing. The journey through such distinctions is necessary and self-negating. A later authorial instruction in the same conversation places the context clause before the silence clause, so that context carries #4, silence #5, and the final mind clause the 5→0 return. The complete quotation above preserves the canonical compilation's two-line witness, which still has silence before context. The revised order is stated here as Taylor's instruction, not silently substituted for the verse. His further demand is to derive the positions from the primary determinations, rather than assign an already finished poem to six slots. **Human-amplified: yes** for this withheld-referent and sequence correction. ### FT-P20 — [The notion born of difference] > the notion born of difference is incremental, > depending for presence of the inferential, > whilst speaking plain not a hint tangential, > broaching it's branches without asking for permissions consensual [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q020) · Extracted authorial poem. Taylor calls these four clauses the preceding poem's encapsulation. The notion grows through difference and depends upon inference for presence, yet speaks plainly and branches without requesting consent. This short work has its own beginning, cadence and end even in that close relation to FT-P19. Keeping both complete allows the encapsulation to gather the longer movement without replacing it. ### FT-P21 — [The infinite multiplied by the infinitesimal] > The infinite multiplied by the infinitesimal makes a a field differential nested in and made of the principle of sameness - I am the same, I know difference - I have knowledge of difference, I am seeking it's sameness [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q021) · Extracted authorial poem. The sentence first makes a differential field from the infinite and infinitesimal, then follows four first-person clauses: being the same, knowing difference, having that knowledge, and seeking sameness. The repetitions and changes of verb matter as much as the two opening quantities. Taylor's subsequent correction requires both a static and a processual reading: a thing and its thinging, definite identity and the activity through which it is specified. Multiplication carries expansive plenitude together with precise differentiation. He then calls for a second, divisional reading. The first passage must complete 0/1, its 4+2 field and 5→0 return before the inversion to 1/0 opens a full 4′+2′ and 5′→0′ passage back to 0/1. Division does not replace the original word multiplied in the verse, and the inverse half cannot be compressed into the first return. This authorial reading restores the ordered movement around the sentence; it does not declare an indeterminate product or quotient a valid calculus identity. Independent mathematical claims require the native matheme's derivation and their own mathematical conditions. **Human-amplified: yes** for the two-pass, noun/verb correction. ### FT-P22 — What is it to feel? > What is it to feel? > To take in and undergo, how else does a feeling know? > Yo churn or chime, no wonder, whether on a dime > Or once in a while, riled or reconciled by time. > I am either a sea's plaything or the captain of the "mine". > To feel is to live in what lives through you, > It is the way I quaked when the winds blew through, > Until it's how I relate to the one in the boots. > Feeling has it's way and away, until the day, anew, > Where dawn's heart in mind, or rather Venus holds > And yet unfolds intuition, Sophia, martian, though kind and bold, > Solid and chilling where we can't afford to fold, > Mellifluous sunshine for the quiet estates of old [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q022) · Extracted authorial poem. Feeling first takes in and undergoes. The sea's plaything and captain of the mine offer two positions inside that experience; the winds still pass through the one who quakes. Taylor's explicit correction identifies the boots through quaking in my boots. Relating to the one in them means becoming able to relate consciously to one's own emotions and to the feeler who undergoes them. An earlier conversational gloss made the relation primarily one to a brother; Taylor rejected that reading. The dawning movement consequently changes how feeling is lived, rather than promising that feeling will disappear. Venus holds and unfolds intuition; Sophia and the martian occur in a field capable of kindness, boldness, chilling solidity and mellifluous warmth. These changing tonal offices complete this poem. They do not license the separate, still-unmined Venus–Lucifer–Christ genealogy. **Human-amplified: yes** for the self-relation and boots correction; no additional doctrinal identity is asserted for its named figures. ### FT-P23 — [How many layers to a surface] > How many layers to a surface > Aeons in a purchase > Let the shoe fit > But return it > > Earnest make the sole phew > Rule in aeternus, > Married to the quiet stone, > The worthless > > I reside beneath sense > So sense I can make > Take heed not of what flies > By the way > > Blake would have kissed > The joy as it flew by his face > So make no bones > Lest bones be made [Complete source witness](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-personal-poetry-corpus-q023) · Extracted authorial poem. A purchase carries aeons and a surface carries layers, but the shoe that fits must still be returned. Sole, phew, eternal rule and the quiet worthless stone place value under pressure from the poem's sounds. Residing beneath sense then permits sense-making, while what flies cannot be possessed by attending only to its passage. The final stanza names Blake and the fleeting joy before closing on bones. Making a fixed claim risks becoming what has been fixed. Blake remains the poem's named poetic allusion; no additional Blake quotation or textual attribution is manufactured here. ## #4 — Images that retain the relation they expose The prose images give the same field material operations beyond verse. A token breaks, a dot is erased, an optical figure turns, attention is drawn into a concealed centre. Each image has its own conditions and aftermath. Their adjacency here gathers Taylor's authored use; it does not turn a historical emblem, a psychological operator and an institutional diagnosis into the same kind of evidence. ### The fish describing water A fish attempts to describe the water in which it lives. Every distinction it makes is already sustained by what it tries to place before itself as an object. Leaving the condition in order to obtain an independent view would remove the life from which the description is being made. The image therefore turns the question back toward the describing subject: how does its own act disclose the condition it cannot encompass? In [*The Definition of God*, Draft 3](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md), this is the pressure of definition from within. A faithful definition succeeds through acknowledging the precise limit at which its subject cannot become one more bounded thing. Taylor's corrections keep that failure productive: the subject is the referent's condition, and vague surrounding language cannot substitute for deriving the distinction. The first-person return is earned through the attempt to define, not reached by abandoning it at the outset. **Human-amplified: yes** for the authored fish/definition relation. The image **returns-to** [A01's faithful definition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md). ### A definition made into a cage or a window A frame can enclose what it claims to show, or delimit an opening through which one sees beyond it. The cage makes its own bounds the creature's world. The window keeps a definite frame while admitting light and air from what exceeds that frame. The difference requires the frame in both cases; removing all determination would remove the window as well. Draft 3 gives definition this double possibility. Its assertion first encounters its failure; the acknowledged failure then lets the definition succeed in pointing to what exceeds its grasp. The movement passes through the opposed claims and their containing field to the first-person recognition and return. This image gives the poems' panes, sky and limits a related prose operation without making those occurrences interchangeable. **Human-amplified: yes** for the cage/window distinction in faithful definition. It **qualifies** [the living symbol and idol](../../../../episteme/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md): the living symbol retains the passage its form makes possible. ### The kaleidoscope and its changing centre A turn of the kaleidoscope rearranges the relations among the visible pieces. The pieces do not license every possible description: what can be seen depends upon their arrangement and the instrument through which the arrangement appears. Taylor's P2 encounter with Singh's introduction to the *Parātrīśikā-vivaraṇa* takes this as an image of manifold interpretation that remains answerable to its object. A word becomes a local orbital centre. Other meanings gather around it; turning the relation brings a different coherence into view. Centralising a notion recognises its identity with the Supreme; decentring it affirms the Supreme's transcendence of that particular form. Both actions belong to the authored image. A centre can consequently be real in its local office without becoming the final centre of everything. The accompanying mandala opens concentrically from a home toward foreign contexts and returns to its anchor. The cymatic comparison makes patterned alignment imaginable, but the notebook does not establish a physical law proving an increase of philosophical truth with frequency. Likewise, its buoyancy/boy-on-sea pun is Taylor's phonetic play about the word sustaining a crossing; it is not historical etymology. The [Singh/Abhinavagupta source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE.md) **sources** the encounter's textual lead and distinguishes Singh's introduction from Abhinavagupta's commentary. The kaleidoscope, orbital centre and centralising/decentring operation are Taylor's authored response, **human-amplified: yes**. The source's edition and passage-verification debt does not erase that response, and the response does not settle the debt. This movement **returns-to** [Vāk](../../../../episteme/arguments/A06-Vak.md), where a word's determinate office opens a relation to the field that gives it meaning. ### The cube that reverses while its field remains The lines of a cube admit a change of orientation. A face that had receded comes forward; the earlier view can return without the marks themselves being replaced. As long as one reading occupies the whole field, the alternative appears only through a flip. Taylor's core uses that reversal to approach a further change: the context holds the readings in relation, so that neither has to become the final account of the figure. The core places this within the passage through I, you and it, then the contextual release of their exclusivity, recognition of the one appearing act, and return. The context is not a fourth competing face of the cube. It is the field in which the differently oriented readings can be understood together. The image carries this authorial contextual operation, **human-amplified: yes**; it does not claim an experimental finding that incompatible depth percepts are literally simultaneous. It **returns-to** [diaphaneity](../../../../episteme/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) and **qualifies** the [world-picture's passage toward an atlas](../../../../episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md). The atlas retains the situated readings and their relations rather than installing one more victorious picture. ### Centres without a final circumference From within an experience, the world is given through this centre. Encounter with another internality changes the demand: the other is also a centre, and its world cannot be exhausted by its appearance in mine. Further internalities can be nested within and across these relations. Their reality does not await a last external spectator who would enclose them all. The centre-everywhere image gives this plurality an indefinite circumference. It removes the demand for a final enclosing view while retaining actual centres and the differences between them. Aperspectivality is therefore not achieved by evacuating perspective. In the authored intake, it makes perspective transparent to the conditions and other perspectives it cannot monopolise. **Human-amplified: yes** for the nested-internality operation. No historical attribution of the sphere formula is claimed here. The image **returns-to** [objective internality](../../../../episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md). ### The broken token and the kept counterpart A token is divided and its halves are carried apart. Each party keeps a piece whose broken edge refers to the absent other. Recognition later occurs through their fit. The break has not merely damaged a complete object: keeping the fracture lets a relation be authenticated across absence. The intervening time matters because trust has to endure before the reunion can make its basis present. Taylor's copula and ballein programme gives this material scene an authored formal return. One half cannot authenticate itself by announcing that it is the whole; nor could an indiscriminate heap of pieces perform the particular fit. The distinct parties and the kept counterpart are necessary to recognition. **Human-amplified: yes** for fracture retained as a means of recognition. [Symbol, account and trust](../../../../episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **sources** the philological and material-historical work; [root Symbolon](../../../../README.md) carries the formal office. This scene supplies neither a duplicate root derivation nor an invented ancient tale. ### Two dots, one orientation, and the erased other The black and white fields retain a dot of each within the other. In Taylor's diagrammatic use, those retained others make the whole living: the distinguished sides do not sever their mutual implication. A one-dot reading gives an orientation within that relation. Erasing the dots changes the operation. The two fields remain visibly opposed, but their capacity to retain the other has disappeared. The final quilt places both annihilation and arrogation at this danger. One route cancels the opposition into nothing; the other claims a pole as absolute and suppresses its dependence. The erased-dot image makes visible how monopoly can preserve the outer form of distinction while eliminating the reciprocal relation that made it generative. **Human-amplified: yes** for Taylor's two-dot/one-dot/no-dot operation. It **returns-to** [the two logics](../../../../episteme/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). This exact appointment is authored QL imagery; it is not attributed to an ancient Taoist text. ### Bohr's emblem as a separate reception witness The programme brings Bohr's taijitu emblem beside the complementarity discussion. Its office is historical reception: the physicist's emblem is a particular use of a received figure, with an armorial production setting and a motto to be verified. Taylor's erased-dot construction changes a diagram to expose an operation; the Bohr witness concerns an actual emblem that must be recovered on its own terms. The distinction bears on the physics comparison itself. Complementary experimental arrangements and the selection made within one measurement are different operations. An image of opposed yet related sides cannot collapse them into one generic cut. The programme admits the emblem as a subordinate witness, while the exact provenance, motto and reproduction source remain outstanding. **Human-amplified: yes** for the programme's bounded complementarity relation; **human-amplified: no** for any further symbolic reading or identity with Taylor's erased-dot sequence. No unverified armorial image or motto is reproduced here. ### The black sun and the radiating star Attention and labour move toward a centre. At the public edge, actions are presented as work done for others; deeper within, the power to decide how that work is used is less visible. The black-sun image gathers these movements as capture: energy is received without an answering circulation that renews the people and relations supplying it. The radiating star changes the destination of the intake. What reaches the centre becomes available outward as generative power. The adopted social-power unit gives this contrast a complete Work/Play inversion. Play opens the freedom of an interior life; Need makes its dependence felt; Sacrifice concerns what is given and received; Decision orders that exchange; Love keeps the persons in relation; Work makes the relation publicly available. Healthy work expresses the life sustaining it, and healthy play permits creation and contemplation. The coequal Name series—Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image—articulates what this lived Power movement brings into expression. Power includes provision and care. The black sun concerns its capture, not the existence of Power itself. Under inversion, the public work channel becomes performance while effective decision moves into concealed play. The source's four concentric rings give that separation a changing depth. Outer philanthropy supplies the visible face of benevolence, compared to Neptune's distant orbit. The middle concentration of capital supplies stabilising gravity, compared to Jupiter. Inner fixers mediate between power and its instruments under the image of Mercury's proximity. The innermost corona is a further relation: compromising material binds participants through their capacity to expose one another. Here mutual vulnerability can make departure costly. These are differentiated offices in Taylor's adopted diagnosis. The astronomical imagery makes their visibility and proximity imaginable; it does not establish the institutional claims by physical law or prove a universal history of power. The same contraction reaches identification. A person can be permitted an identity as worker, consumer or public profile while the depth of their life ceases to count. The unit's false accounting excludes interior experience because it cannot be entered in the authorised ledger, then treats that exclusion as absence of reality. What a person has suffered, loved or understood is disqualified before the account is made. The image's return therefore concerns who may determine what I am, as well as where labour and attention flow. Recognition can widen the relation within which a particular identity is held without requiring the person to disappear into a larger collective. The attention sequence has three stages. Cynicism continues to direct energy toward what it distrusts. Exhaustion then brings disengagement. The resulting blankness leaves a field ready for re-inscription: control can operate through deciding which questions become available before answers are offered. Exposing the performance alone has consequently not returned power to those sustaining it. The changed relation must let work, attention and judgement return as their generative capacity. This gives the radiating star its consequence. A newly exclusive framework would repeat the demand for allegiance; the authored return changes the relation to frameworks and the possibility of answering them. **Human-amplified: yes** for the adopted capture/circulation, Work/Play, four-ring and false-accounting operations. They **return-to** [power, delegated labour and return](../../../../episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md), and **qualify** [arbitration's usurpation of measure](../../../../episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md). Particular political or criminal allegations, historical universalizations and psychiatric equivalences in the raw unit require their own evidence and are not reproduced as findings. Its comparisons to separate spectral-chain tellings retain those tellings' own homes; they do not add synthetic poems or substitute for this image's complete political movement. ### City, bomb, surveillance, and the counterfeit image A city shelters a plurality of lives and gathers the energy that sustains them. Its organised power can also turn against its inhabitants. The bomb makes a destructive possibility material: the built field can be annihilated. Surveillance can preserve the buildings and daily activity while capturing the people who move within them. The maintained appearance of a functioning city therefore cannot by itself establish that its constitutive relation remains free. The AI and deepfake extension introduces another power. An image can remain persuasive while its claimed source has been broken or counterfeited. This differs from destroying the city and from monitoring an actual person: the encounter is directed toward an appearance whose asserted origin cannot be trusted. Material destruction, capture of persons, and counterfeit source-image are three distinct failures in the programme's movement through technoscientific power. The God-image enters as the cultural question of what a collective places at the source and end of its organised power. The intended Giegerich passages on the nuclear bomb and technology remain an acquisition and telling debt; this page does not construct a universal causal history from religion through city to AI. **Human-amplified: yes** for the authored destruction/capture/counterfeit differentiation. The image **qualifies** [mediating office and source authority](../../../../episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md). The technical onset scene of [the mirror that moves first](../mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md) retains its separate whole: an instrument initiating a return is a different relation from counterfeiting an image's source. The final four operators belong to one encounter with alterity. Their different offices prevent the word Other from covering over the difference between a power within the psyche and another person who meets it. ### God as Other A finite mind confronts source, law or archetypal totality as something exceeding its own possession. The image gives that exceeding an address in God as Other. A divine-mind reading, in which the divine Self encounters its manifestation, changes the register of the relation. The finite mind cannot simply claim that office for itself because it has produced an image of the divine. **Human-amplified: yes** for the programme's distinction of these registers. ### Shadow as other-self What the ego disowns returns as internal difference. Its completed self-picture cannot accommodate what nevertheless acts within its life. The shadow's otherness makes that incompleteness effective: recognition requires a changed relation to what had been excluded. This is an encounter within psychic life; it does not establish that another person is only a projection of the ego. **Human-amplified: yes** for the programme's other-self office. ### Friend as my-self's-other A friend shares a world while exceeding the image I make of them. Their response can alter our relation because its source is not exhausted by my account of it. Here the other is another centre, and friendship requires that excess to remain active. Assimilating the friend to an inner figure would remove the very interlocutor through whom the relation changes. **Human-amplified: yes** for the authored interpersonal distinction. ### Alien or enemy as externalised uncertainty Denied uncertainty can be assigned to an external negative pole. The enemy then appears to carry what the self's account has refused to include. The operation is a projection and a severance: it converts an unresolved relation into a supposed property of the other. Recognising that operation restores responsibility for the account doing the assigning. It does not imply that every actual danger is imaginary or that every adversary is an inner figure. **Human-amplified: yes** for this specified projection operation. Together these four operators **return-to** [self and other without possession](../../../../episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md). The programme lets Jung's inner face meet the interpersonal pressure associated with Levinas while preserving their different source tasks. It does not turn the four operators into fixed native determinations or four universal character classes. ## #5→0 — Keeping the opening in the form The complete poems make return something more exact than a common theme. Play begins again after checkmate; the six routes fall through their loop; the distressed speaker must reconcile what he could not simply eradicate; the fitting shoe is returned. Each ending qualifies the work that precedes it. The prose images give that demand different material tests: a kept counterpart can recognise another, an erased counterpart cannot; a centre can return what it receives, or consume the conditions of its own power. The [Two Ones](../../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **receive** the exact numerical and verbal movement of FT-P04 and FT-P11–16. [Faithful definition](../../../../episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) receives the fish, frame and speaking limit; [Vāk](../../../../episteme/arguments/A06-Vak.md) receives the language that can yield while remaining precise. These are operation-specific returns. They do not make all twenty-three poems interchangeable illustrations of one argument. Further comparisons, including a fixed mythic identity for the brothers of FT-P18 or the figures of FT-P22, remain **human-amplified: no** unless their own authored relation is recovered. Neumann's [shared structuration](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) **qualifies** the relation of emergence, differentiation and renewed interplay across this field. Its common ground does not remove the place, medium, author or date of an occurrence. A geography can trace the cultural homes and encounters from which an image arrives; a temporal account can follow composition, revision and reception; the shared archetypal structure can make their changing offices comparable. None of these three can replace the others. The local centre remains real within these relations. In the recursive Bimba operation, a reference can genuinely occupy a relative original's office while remaining pratibimba in a wider relation; this preserves the contextual office and the wider order of dependence together. The canonical compilation supplies all twenty-three complete poems. The separate raw site file cited by that compilation remains unlocated in the current local search, and the dated journal corrections do not authorise silent alteration of its text. The unmined Venus naming/reception vector retains its separate telling gate; protected experiential material retains its use-choice gate and is not narrated here. Historical emblem, edition and technoscientific source debts remain where their claims arise. Those limits leave the authored works intact and the way back to their particular words open.

# A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition

## #0

The one asking what the Subject is is already present in the asking. A thought can appear, a self-image can change, and an account of the mind can be examined; the appearing of any of these is already given to the one undertaking the examination. The Subject is this immediate pole of the inquiry. Adding another image to the account does not place that pole among its contents.

Definition is an act of determination: it distinguishes, excludes, relates and lets consequences follow. Its clarity depends on giving a term a place within a field of intelligibility. When the term names the Subject, or when *God* names the source and condition of a world, this power meets its own condition. It can represent what makes determination possible, but that representation is itself a determination. Treating it as exhaustive would install the determining condition as one more determined occupant of the field.

**A definition is faithful when its own determining act remains visible inside the account it gives.** It makes a positive claim and remains answerable for it. Its finitude does not make it false. It becomes unfaithful when the achieved boundary is treated as possession of the source from which boundary-making is possible. [Faithful Definition](../concepts/C02-Faithful-Definition.md) defines this obligation; [Subject / Defined Indefinability](../concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) defines the asymmetry it must preserve.

The Subject is *definedly indefinable*. This identifies the precise office that an exhaustive description cannot occupy. It does not shelter a hidden substance behind appearances. Nor does it leave the God-term indeterminate: a word that discriminates nothing cannot distinguish a source from another projection. The definition must therefore be attempted. Its fidelity becomes available through what the attempt does, including its encounter with its own limit.

Here the source/appearance relation has two different offices within one whole. The singular One is unobjectifiable; the polyvalent All is the articulated field of appearances, differences and relations. Appearance appears in awareness, while awareness is encountered through appearing. This mutual relation does not make the two poles interchangeable objects or equal causal producers. [The Two Ones](A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) grounds this distinction concretely: `0` names singular One and `1` polyvalent All, rather than two bare labels, “ground” and “mark.” The [Primordial Symbolon](A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) grounds their whole native sequence. A01 follows the local act of definition within that field.

## #1

**We define God:** God is the whole that any coherent representational system participates in and necessarily fails to contain. The [direct Definition of God manuscript](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md) sources this philosophical proposition. Its subject is the relation of representation to its own condition. A system's account can articulate that relation; the system does not thereby acquire a position outside everything that makes its articulation possible.

The definition's predicates already carry a predicament. The manuscript presses four received omni-attributes: omnipotence, omniscience, omnipresence and omnibenevolence. Each extends an unlimited vector through a domain—power, knowledge, presence and goodness. Yet the claimed unlimitedness puts each attribute at issue. A power unable to bind itself would be bounded by that inability. Omnipotence therefore includes real self-limitation; omniscience reaches the sealed blind spot; omnipresence includes genuine absence. The predicament must be actual. A freedom that only pretended to forget, while secretly retaining every answer in the finite life, would not have entered the limit it claims the freedom to make.

**Omnivalence** and **omni-lemmicity** complete the four in this authorial construction. Omnivalence names the condition from which the whole valence-field differentiates: generative and destructive, auspicious and terrible, light and shadow. Goodness and its negation lie within that differentiation; the ground is not assigned an equal portion of each by a measure placed outside it. Omni-lemmicity names the capacity of every predicate to become its own issue. Every fork, undecidable and self-obstacle is internal to the field of freedom. The four explicit attributes unfold an implicate pair: the full field of valence and the self-predicament through which any of its predicates can invert. This is the particular `4+2` the definition performs, not a count imposed on an arbitrary list.

Its freedom includes genuine limiting, forgetting and becoming its own obstacle. What was asserted as unlimited capacity returns as the finite aperture of a particular life: power as binding, knowledge as the blind spot, presence as abandonment, the full valence-field as this wound. The name can be broken and its image overthrown because the source is not exhausted by either. The predicates lead into the defining act's own undoing. This is the native philosophical argument; its force does not depend on treating the theological set as a formal system to which Gödel's theorems have already been applied.

The assertion gives us something definite to examine. It identifies the intended referent, distinguishes it from a further object in the field, and commits the speaker to consequences. [Determination](../concepts/C03-Determination.md) defines the cutting operation: to say what counts is also to establish what falls outside the count. [Constitutive Exclusion](A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) qualifies the result by returning attention to the exclusions on which its identity depends. An omitted condition does not cease to operate because the definition has omitted it.

The act also requires a name, an instance and a circumstance of identification. A name alone cannot determine what is being identified here. To count “one” already requires a discrimination, and to identify that one again requires a relation across difference. Frank's protected encounter with [Kripke](../sources/analytic-philosophy/kripke/kripke-1981-naming-and-necessity/SOURCE.md) grounds this pressure beneath a polished account of naming: who identifies, what is identified, and in what circumstance cannot simply be subtracted from the name's use. This is the author's derivational use of that encounter, not an attribution of QL or its counting architecture to Kripke.

The [copula](../concepts/C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) defines the identifying relation rather than collapsing its terms. “God is…” has a speaker, an assertion and a referent whose relation the assertion undertakes. The words are already doing something. The first move becomes exact enough to encounter the consequences of what it does.

## #2

**We fail to define God.** “God is the indefinable” remains a determinate sentence. It marks a boundary, assigns a name and asks to count as a true account. The defining act has not escaped the relation it describes. The direct manuscript gives the image of a fish describing water while swimming in it: the description belongs to the very circumstance it seeks to make available.

The failure is precise. It is the failure of final enclosure. A representation of the condition of appearing appears again; an account of the present act becomes something that can be examined in a further present act. Refining the representation can deepen its truth without abolishing that difference. [The Immutable Gap](../concepts/C05-Immutable-Gap.md) qualifies the promise of completion here, while [Formal Limit](../concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) defines the limit as internally generated rather than an arbitrary prohibition imposed on inquiry.

Self-reference generates the pressure internally. If the account claims completeness, it must include the conditions of its own determining. When it represents those conditions, the represented act and the act now representing it remain distinct. The attempt at closure renews the difference it meant to close. This is why the failure is informative: it identifies an office the account cannot assume while remaining an account.

Assertion and non-enclosure have different objects: one claims an intelligible relation; the other denies that the claim possesses its own condition. Their distinction permits exact, corrigible and transmissible knowledge. [A03](A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) extends this pressure into the formal-limit argument. Its mathematical and logical neighbours retain their own hypotheses; the present operation does not turn every representation into a Gödelian formal system.

## #3

**We succeed because we fail.** The definition now includes the difference its own activity produces. It says what it can say and makes its non-exhaustion available within that saying. It performs the relation it names: a determinate account answering to what makes the account possible.

The direct manuscript's cage and window give this change its image. A closed image occupying the source-office is a cage where a window was needed. A window has a definite frame. Its opening depends on that frame without claiming that everything disclosed belongs inside it. The image is an internal figure of the operation, not an external proof. [Living Symbol / Idol](../concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) qualifies the difference: a symbol discloses through its achieved form; an idol promotes that form into possession of its source. [Image, Valuation and Possession](A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) extends the problem beyond definitions to the images through which a world becomes valuable and actionable.

What the definition cannot enclose is now operative in how it means. It can be binding without being final. It remains liable to correction by a renewed encounter rather than protecting itself against the condition it claims to name. The failure of capture gives the account a return route.

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole field](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) grounds this relation: a determinate Symbol discloses; an Account makes the disclosure answerable; Trust permits committed use while retaining the possibility of encounter, consequence and revision. A01 consumes this as **evidence register 3, operational homology**. It makes no claim of common philological descent among “God,” “Subject,” “definition,” “symbol,” “account” and “trust.” Here the account answers to source without substituting itself for source.

Omnivalence becomes concrete through **lack**. Becoming reaches toward a satisfaction; each satisfaction is the perishing of that becoming into what it has achieved, which becomes a condition for a further act rather than final possession of the source of reaching. In the manuscript's operation, lack is the chargeless aperture from which particular valences arise. The direction of power gives the act its moral charge: **does it enslave and claim, or release and make free?** The availability of every valence makes the direction consequential. It does not excuse the enslaving choice. A finite person used as a means has been subjected to an actual act of possession; an account of the whole remains answerable for that act.

This brings the predicate's predicament into the life of a measure. [A19, Complex as Local Arbitration Regime](A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) extends this pressure into a local ordering that takes its criterion for the whole; A24 extends it into the usurpation of measure. The complex's local competence can survive return to the wider field. The power to release includes releasing a definition's claim to final jurisdiction without destroying its capacity to discriminate.

This also specifies fidelity's demand. Simply suspending every determination would leave nothing with which to act or answer. Faithful definition must risk a positive account and retain the means by which that account can change. Its success is the achieved relation, including the limit that keeps the relation alive.

## #4

**We neither succeed nor fail.** Success and failure, taken separately, each name only part of the activity now available. Assertion, failed enclosure and successful disclosure belong to one situated movement. What was sought as an entity standing still before the definition has disclosed the activity in which defining itself occurs.

The circumstance is no longer merely background. [Context / Context Frame](../concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) grounds the distinction between the lived field and its selected representation; [Mediation / Pramāṇa](../concepts/C10-Mediation-Pramana.md) defines the mediating office between knower and known. The definition has a body, a history, a concern and someone for whom its truth matters. [Diaphaneity](../concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) extends this visibility: the determining circumstance becomes available through its determinations. A01 thereby presages [A04](A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md).

This completing fourth does not add a fourth pronoun beside I, you and it. Nor does it provide a spectator free of circumstance. It lets the relations among perspectives become available together. A01 compares this personed and contextual pressure with the author's source encounters in [Singh's introduction to the Parātrīśikā-Vivaraṇa](../sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE.md) and [Gebser](../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md). Their historical claims and passage readiness remain distinct from the native operation. [Vāk](A06-Vak.md) extends the address through which I and you are situated; [Prakāśa–Vimarśa](A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) grounds the appearing and reflexive recognition through which the relation is lived.

Yet even this whole account still speaks **about** God. It says that the referent is a source, a limit, a dynamic or a context. It can accurately describe the involvement of the person defining and still describe that involvement from the position of an account. This is the exact asymmetry the next move must preserve. Context makes the turn possible; its description has not already performed the first-person recognition.

## #5→0

**I Am.** The utterance enters from within the activity whose condition the definition has tried to name. The one who was defining was always the one being defined. What appeared as the subject of a proposition is recognised as the Subject of the present act.

In the manuscript's God/Subject operation, this speaks **as** God from within rather than adding a final statement about God from outside. “God” names the source-condition; the recognition is of Present Being, not the construction of an image of a higher being. The utterance does not award a represented personality ownership of the whole. It changes the register of the inquiry: the source that could not be possessed as an object is present as the act undertaking the inquiry. The [native core theorem spine](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) sources this fifth-position reversal and its return. Its broad theological comparisons are authorial readings, not a claim here that every named tradition teaches one verified doctrine.

The present I can describe its thoughts, habits, memories and self-image. Each description has a truth and an office. None contains the act now knowing it. Q27's distinction among selfing, the local self, the self-thing, Subjectivity and Self prevents this recognition from hardening into a new proprietor. Frank's protected [Watson encounter](../sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE.md) qualifies that distinction: selfing is an activity, and a person remains situated and addressable without being an independently existing self-thing. The authorial encounter is provenance for this use; copied passages in its NOTES do not acquire external evidential standing merely by being read.

The return is therefore to the capacity for further determination. Recognition does not abolish the names or the differences through which it became available. The [Mono–Poly development](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mono-poly-two-ones/SOURCE.md) grounds the return: singular One and polyvalent All remain one relation with different offices. The native sixfold has a concrete binary and binary-of-binary construction, `2 + 2² = 6`; A11 and A18 carry its full derivation and the distinction between six positions and eight determinations. The present page's six positions perform definition specifically. They are not six universal glossary meanings or six additional canonical identities.

A01 returns-to [A02, the copula's self-identity through difference](A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md): identification can be faithful without exhaustive enclosure. The personal circuit reaches “Am” through the relation that began in “is”; its identification is now staked from within. It also returns-to [A23, Trust and Faith under Formal Limit](A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md), where [C48](../concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) defines commitment without epistemic possession. The [trust revision](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/SOURCE.md) sources the practical consequence: trust can be investigated, corrected, withdrawn and renewed. Fidelity does not guarantee harmlessness.

The consequences retain their separate homes. [A24](A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) extends the danger of a derivative measure occupying source-office; [A25](A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) extends the argument into the authority of mediation without confusing it with the source of authority. [A27](A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) qualifies any claim to possess the Other through a model: inclusion in the whole does not make another person a possession of me. The first-person recognition leaves this address and difference active.

## #0

A situated view is already an accomplishment: a world becomes distinguishable from somewhere. Its objects acquire depth, salience and relation through a placement that the resulting image can conceal. [[A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit|A03]] grounds the task by showing why adding more objects never exhausts that placement. Diaphaneity follows the conditioning relation back through the view. “My view of the world” becomes legible at once as a disclosure of a world and as a disclosure of the situated viewer through whom that world has taken this form.

The two orientations retain their asymmetry. A viewer acts, selects and answers; a world, body, language, history and concern give that viewer its present possibilities. Neither direction alone tells the whole event. [[C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood|C07]] grounds this dependence, while [[C08-Context-Context-Frame|C08]] defines a bounded arrangement of conditions that can be stated, revised and used. Diaphaneity is the achieved readability of their operation through a determination.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE|Gebser's source house]] historicises the emergence of the perspectival sector. Its selected-edition passage map follows Giotto's depth and Petrarch's landscape through Alberti's visual pyramid and Leonardo's optical articulation (pp.11–21). Perspective makes a positioned ego-world visible; its technical precision can also fix the observer and observed within the very sector it renders. Aperspectivity releases the exclusive validity of that sector through the co-presence and transparency of structures (pp.1–3); it does not erase the powers of rational articulation.

Frank's [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P5 - Gebser|P5 — Gebser]] extends this history into the lived demand of context. Seeing through becomes “being with the text,” including text and subtext. The observer belongs to the situation's outcome. Body, inheritance, concern and consequence are active in seeing; removing them from the account can make participation harder to recognise while leaving its effects fully operative. Impartiality demands that this involvement be acknowledged and situated. It cannot be obtained by indifference.

The P5 formulations are Taylor's authorial interpretation, sourced here as such. The search for the last word on what is becomes the power to determine what matters.

The whole image must retain its return. The Father names the ordering ground whose absence cannot be repaired by a surrogate; when a surrogate takes that office, ordering becomes a ruler claiming to stand above its own law. Seeing through the Father restores the relation to the transcendent that its appropriation occludes. Context therefore carries an investment in what the determination does to those situated within its reach. It is answerability to the ground and consequences of judgment, including the observer's desire to own the standard.

[[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|A24]] extends the usurpation of measure; [[A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority|A25]] extends the distinction between mediating office and source authority; [[A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|A35]] extends the invested care for origins. # A06 — Vāk

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument; historical Argument 16 and live `10-vak.md` remain provenance.

## #0

Vāk makes articulation itself part of ontology. A word is not merely a label attached after a world has already been made; articulation is one route by which a field differentiates, becomes meaningful, and enters audible, written, coded or enacted form. The Śaiva accounts of levels of speech matter here because they refuse the modern assumption that meaning begins only at the finished external sign. Unsayable capacity, visionary or formative speech, mental articulation and gross utterance belong to one descent whose later products carry the history of their formation.

## #1

For this essay, the point is not to import a fixed four-level schema into every communicative event. It is to establish that sign, sound, image, intention and action can be stages or aspects of one differentiating movement. Paśyantī's “seeing” speech and Nāda's vibratory office are especially important because they stand before the hard partition of visual and acoustic objects. They make intelligible why the Arche-Topos can be refracted as topology, music, word and patterned manifestation without those registers being declared identical.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE|Singh / Abhinavagupta source house]] sources this account through the separate P2 and P3 authorial notebooks. Their introduction leads give Parā Vāk the office of the Supreme Word from which letters and words derive; Paśyantī and Madhyamā name formative and mental articulation, while Vaikharī is the explicit utterance. Introduction, translation and Abhinavagupta's commentary are different textual voices. The current source-matched notebook passages do not make every speech-level description a verified book quotation.

The [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P3 - Beyond Para-Trisika|P3 encounter]] develops the persons from address itself. An I addresses a you concerning what can be spoken of as he, she or it. These are offices of relation, not permanently assigned kinds of being. An object spoken of can become the you addressed; an addressee can answer as I. The source-side image of addressing a mountain and then speaking through its first-person identity makes the exchange concrete. A shift of grammatical office transforms the relation without first requiring that the object receive a new substance.

## #2

[[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT|Q27's Bāhiya/address contribution]] sources a second operation. Its reading of the instruction interrupts the appropriation by which the seen becomes what I possess or essentially am; the instruction nevertheless addresses Bāhiya, who can receive and respond. The second person is the transformative interval. A speech-act which loosens identification still needs the situated relation in which someone can hear it.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE|Watson's source house]] contextualises this authorial development through selfing and the interpersonal encounter. Frank's protected notes distinguish the fabricated self-thing from the non-objectifiable Self and insist on retaining address while appropriation is dismantled. Its thesis/book and nested-source collation boundaries remain in the house.

[[A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency|A04]] grounds the circumstance in which these persons can exchange places.
